shape: a small thing you fought as a kid and would welcome now, pinned to one object

slides.text: i spent years fighting the [[eight o'clock bedtime]] on the hall clock, and now it sounds like a prize.

caption:
eight o'clock used to mean missing out on everything.
now it just means the day is finally over.
send this to the friend who falls asleep before the film starts.
alt: a one line slide about fighting an eight o'clock bedtime as a child and wanting it now, pictured with a small green donkey standing peacefully with eyes closed
hook_options: i spent years fighting the [[eight o'clock bedtime]] on the hall clock, and now it sounds like a prize.
i used to fight being sent to bed at eight o'clock, and tonight it feels like mercy.
i spent my childhood escaping the eight o'clock bedtime, and now nothing sounds sweeter.
